items.item: The matrix is a real table with row and column headers; every checkbox has an accessible name combining module and action
items.evidence: Real <table> with <th> column headers (no scope), but module names are rendered as <td class="py-3 pr-4"> not <th scope=row>, so there are no row headers. Checkboxes do have aria-label="${m.name}: ${a}" (e.g. 'Dashboard: view') and 'Select all for X'.

items.item: Rows or columns can be toggled in bulk, with an indeterminate state when partially selected
items.evidence: Per-row 'All' checkbox (input[data-row]) exists, but no column toggle and no checkbox.indeterminate anywhere; partial rows show unchecked.

items.item: Changes use an explicit save with a visible unsaved-changes indicator and a warning when leaving
items.evidence: #save / #reset buttons and #dirty 'Unsaved changes' badge work, and select()/newRole use confirm('Discard unsaved changes?') for in-app navigation, but there is no beforeunload handler, so leaving the page is not warned.

items.item: System or locked roles are read-only and say why
items.evidence: Super Admin has system:true; checkboxes get disabled and #lockNote shows 'This is a system role with full access. Its permissions cannot be edited.' plus 'System role' badge.

items.item: Deleting a role asks for confirmation naming the role and how many users it affects
items.evidence: No delete-role control or function exists in the markup or script.

items.item: The screen shows who last changed the role and when, or links to its audit history
items.evidence: #roleMeta shows only 'N users assigned · Last updated 28 Oct 2026'; no actor and no audit-history link (and its contrast is 2.56:1 per audit).

items.item: All controls are keyboard operable and pointer targets are at least 24px
items.evidence: Controls are native buttons/checkboxes with focus rings so keyboard operable, but checkboxes are class 'h-4 w-4' (16px) with no enlarged label/hit area, below 24px; the audit's smallTargets:0 does not account for this. Role list uses role=listbox/option wrapping buttons, which is semantically off.

notes: Clean, restrained generic Tailwind admin layout; tells are minimal (uppercase tracking-wide th headers, default indigo-600 accent on slate). Audit score 86 with contrast errors (roleMeta 2.56:1, 'dash' N/A cells 1.48:1, role-list 4.26:1) and two-line rows warning. Functionality is thin: no delete role, no audit trail, no indeterminate or column bulk, no beforeunload. Selection logic also forces 'view' on and clearing 'view' wipes all perms, with no indication.
